facts.text: Undergraduate applicants must pass an initial prescreening round to be invited to a final audition round, which can be completed in person or by recording.

sources.title: Classical Strings & Harp Prescreening & Audition Procedures
sources.quote: Applicants who pass the prescreen round will be invited to the final audition round. MSM offers in-person and recorded final auditions, except for the Doctor of Musical Arts & Artist Diploma programs, which require an in-person audition.
